verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say remixing creates your own independent copy of a project that you can edit freely on any plan, which covers starting from an existing project. A hands-on community report confirms users can pick a template at signup, so both template and copy-based starts are evidenced. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a template gallery, explicit docs of a browsable community project showcase, detail on what templates cover.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt

citations.quote: Remixing creates your own independent copy that you can edit freely, on any plan.
Signed up for Lovable, picked a template
